source: GME - MI-A intraday auction zonal prices (Italian bidding zones)
description: Zonal prices of the GME intraday auctions MI-A1, MI-A2 and MI-A3 for the Italian bidding zones, EUR/MWh, at GME's native 15-minute resolution. Hourly = average of the quarter-hours; daily = average of the day's periods (MI-A3 covers only part of the day).
